name: Pipeliners - Blog Index
body:
> Index · Pipeliners · 2026-10-13

# Summary
Every Pipeliners blog note in this vault, with status. Sources are `blog-drafts\`, the `blog-*\` build folders, `blog-clusters-2026-07\`, `content-drafts\` and the root draft files. Status comes from the files, the July 21 live blog inventory and the Session Handoff 2026-10-01; "likely live" means build or backup files show a publish step but no file confirms the live URL. The live site has about 51-57 posts in total; only posts with source drafts in this folder have their own note.

# Blog rules (short)
Focus keyword aligned across title, H1, meta, first 100 words, one H2 and a 40-60 word answer; quick answer, key takeaways, question H2s in blue #1a446f, one table, FAQ accordion with `_pipeliners_faq_jsonld`; author Jake Shaker; no prices, no 24/7 or same day, no repipe claims, no "pipe lining"/"pipelining" nouns, no "pipeline", "Pipeliners" not "Pipeliners USA"; featured card 1600x774; title and meta via the post-seo-meta mu-plugin; 2 inbound links; free GSC request indexing. Full list: [Pipeliners - Decisions and Rules](lib:brain-pipeliners-decisions-and-rules).
